Minimum Total Sample Size for an LRTae Design

Source: R/lrtae.R
lrtae_mssn.Rd

Finds the minimum integer total sample size required to attain a requested prospective LRTae power while preserving a requested allocation among the four measurement and validation tiers as closely as integer counts permit. This is a prospective-design calculation and is not an observed-data test.

lrtae_mssn(
  true_control_genotype_frequencies,
  true_case_genotype_frequencies,
  true_sampling_proportions,
  phenotype_misclassification_matrix,
  genotype_misclassification_matrix,
  target_power,
  alpha,
  prop_fallible,
  prop_pheno_validated,
  prop_geno_validated,
  prop_both_validated
)

Arguments

true_control_genotype_frequencies

Numeric vector of true genotype frequencies among controls.

true_case_genotype_frequencies

Numeric vector of true genotype frequencies among cases, in the same category order as true_control_genotype_frequencies.

true_sampling_proportions

Numeric vector of length two containing the true control and case sampling proportions, in that order.

phenotype_misclassification_matrix

Numeric two-by-two matrix whose rows are true phenotype categories (control, case) and whose columns are observed phenotype categories (control, case).

genotype_misclassification_matrix

Numeric square matrix whose rows are true genotype categories and whose columns are observed genotype categories, in the genotype-frequency order.

target_power

Requested power, strictly greater than alpha and less than one.

alpha

Significance level, strictly between zero and one.

prop_fallible

Proportion allocated to fallible phenotype and genotype measurements only.

prop_pheno_validated

Proportion allocated to phenotype validation with fallible genotype measurement.

prop_geno_validated

Proportion allocated to genotype validation with fallible phenotype measurement.

prop_both_validated

Proportion allocated to validation of both phenotype and genotype.

Value

An object of class lrtae_mssn, containing MSSN_total, target_power, achieved_power, achieved_ncp, df, alpha, critical_value, requested allocation proportions, and the four allocated integer tier counts.

Details

The four allocation proportions must be nonnegative and sum to one. For every candidate total N, integer counts are assigned by the largest-remainder (Hamilton) rule: floor N * proportion for each tier, then distribute the remaining individuals in descending order of fractional remainder. Exact ties are resolved in the fixed order: fallible, phenotype validated, genotype validated, both validated. Thus allocated counts always sum exactly to N.

The search doubles an upper bound until it attains target_power, applies integer binary search within the bracket, and explicitly verifies the neighboring design at N - 1. Power at each candidate is evaluated through lrtae_power(), which uses the validated corrected lrtae_ncp() engine, k - 1 degrees of freedom, and a noncentral chi-square distribution.

Examples

lrtae_mssn(
  true_control_genotype_frequencies = c(0.81, 0.18, 0.01),
  true_case_genotype_frequencies = c(0.64, 0.32, 0.04),
  true_sampling_proportions = c(0.5, 0.5),
  phenotype_misclassification_matrix = matrix(
    c(0.95, 0.05, 0.05, 0.95), 2, byrow = TRUE
  ),
  genotype_misclassification_matrix = matrix(
    c(0.950, 0.050, 0.000,
      0.025, 0.950, 0.025,
      0.000, 0.050, 0.950),
    3, byrow = TRUE
  ),
  target_power = 0.80,
  alpha = 0.05,
  prop_fallible = 0.7,
  prop_pheno_validated = 0.1,
  prop_geno_validated = 0.1,
  prop_both_validated = 0.1
)
